screen.name: Home
screen.purpose: Main overview screen displaying the user's recent content and providing quick access to primary application areas.

syncStatusBanner.title: Signed in, not synced
syncStatusBanner.body: Your changes will sync when connection is available.

visualRules: Use global design tokens from design-system.json.
Do not define screen-specific colors.
Do not define screen-specific border radii.
Do not define arbitrary spacing values.
The reference PNG is a visual target, not a source of token values. Do not measure colors, spacing, or radii from it.
Media should remain the strongest visual element inside media cards.
Cards may have different heights depending on their content.
Do not force masonry cards to equal heights.
The create action must remain visually dominant.
The Home navigation item must use the global active navigation state.
FAB add and bottom navigation use Material Symbols Rounded: add, home, calendar_month, sell.
Header actions use Material Symbols Rounded: search, more_vert. Avatar fallback is the user initial, not an icon.
The avatar sits on the top-right, aligned with the page title. Search and more_vert sit below the avatar, not in the title row.
Signed-in-not-synced uses the status banner (person, warning, sync), never the legacy no-synchronize.png header icon.
Do not mix Material Symbols with legacy PNG icons on Home. Do not show no-connection.png or no-synchronize.png.
Bottom navigation destinations are Home, Tasks and Tags only. Do not add Settings as a fourth tab.
The avatar opens the account menu: Profile, Settings, Integrations, Sign out.
The leading icon on every Home card is the task type from design-system icons.taskType, not an image/video icon.
Do not print TODO, TIMER, SCHEDULE or LOCATION as text on the card.
Presence of an image does not change the leading icon.
Current live type is TODO (ETaskType.Basic) using radio_button_unchecked. Do not use check or check_circle.
The card overflow menu is Edit, Duplicate, Add to tags and Delete. Duplicate and Add to tags are visible but disabled until those features exist.
Place the Active / To do / Notes segmented switcher immediately under the Home header and above the optional sync banner.

Active is the default selected mode. The selected segment uses the segmentedControl recipe: dark selected surface, thin teal outline and a teal icon. Inactive segments stay transparent inside the shared container.
Each segment shows an icon, a label and a count. Counts update from live data.
Switching modes filters the existing two-column masonry grid without changing bottom navigation.
A horizontal swipe on the content moves one mode. Active, To do and Notes stay in that order.
The header count names the selected mode: "3 active items", "8 to do items", "12 notes".
Counts reflect every item in that mode, including cards hidden by search.
Done and Cancel stay off Home. Home is the working set: Active, To do and Notes.
Active and To do are workflow-status filters, while Notes is a content category; do not confuse these with task type To do / Calendar / Location.
Task cards retain their task-type icons; Notes cards use Material Symbols Rounded article.

Use Google Material Symbols Rounded article for the Notes tab, with FILL 0, weight 400, optical size 24. Do not use notes, subject, menu, or a generic list icon. Render the exact Material Symbol, not a Lucide or custom SVG substitute.
The attached Home mockup is a visual reference for the segmented control, not a literal data contract: sample cards shown there do not override filtering rules.

activeSelected.description: Default state: Active tab highlighted in teal, counts displayed on all three segments; masonry shows only Active tasks.

todoSelected.description: To do tab highlighted in teal; grid displays To do tasks.

notesSelected.description: Notes tab highlighted in teal; grid displays Notes cards.

reference.description: Home with Active / To do / Notes segmented filter (Active selected by default), sync banner, two-column masonry, FAB and Home/Tasks/Tags bottom navigation.

behavior.countSemantics: Counts reflect all items in each mode, not only visible grid cards.

visual.selectedTreatment: subtle dark teal background with thin teal outline
visual.unselectedTreatment: transparent background, muted text and icons

angular.note: The live Home screen does not yet match this spec. Treat this JSON as the approved target, not a description of the current implementation. Bottom-nav destinations /tasks and /tags are product destinations from the approved design; they are not a claim that those Angular routes already exist. The Active / To do / Notes switcher filters ETaskStatus.Active, ETaskStatus.Todo and ETaskStatus.Notes. Done and Cancel stay off Home.
